Class AbstractRelationalConverter

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.data.relational.core.conversion.AbstractRelationalConverter
All Implemented Interfaces:
RelationalConverter
Direct Known Subclasses:
MappingRelationalConverter
public abstract class AbstractRelationalConverter extends Object implements RelationalConverter
RelationalConverter 实现的基础类。配置 ConfigurableConversionService 并填充基本转换器。允许注册 CustomConversions。
Since:
3.2
Author:
马克·帕卢赫
